description: AI and crawler stance of Swedish websites per month. Returns a list of records; pass next_cursor to get the next page. Fields: month (date): First of the sweep month; tld (varchar): se or nu; domains (bigint): Domains swept; reachable (bigint): Answered over HTTPS; has_robots (bigint): Had a real robots.txt; with_sitemap (bigint): robots.txt declares a sitemap; disallow_all (bigint): Disallow: / for all crawlers; ai_train_no (bigint): Opt out of AI training; ai_train_yes (bigint): Opt in to AI training; content_signal (bigint): Has a Content-Signal line; mentions_mcp (bigint): robots.txt mentions MCP; mentions_llms (bigint): robots.txt references llms.txt. Attribution required when the data is shown: Source: Aleva (aleva.se), CC BY 4.0

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous result, for the next page
